title: Project Sidekick directed-energy weapon

tellings.quote: but then there's also project sidekick which is a weapon.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked in the 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, says that alongside the craft work there was also something called Project Sidekick, which he describes simply as "a weapon." He mentions it to Michels in passing as something he knew of first-hand, and if true it would mean the site was building weapons as well as studying craft.
